</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AE_z8UT1eEO6SBk" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company continually evaluates the likelihood of the realization of deferred tax assets and adjusts the carrying amount of the deferred
tax assets by the valuation allowance to the extent the future realization of the deferred tax assets is more likely than not. The Company
considers many factors when assessing the likelihood of future realization of its deferred tax assets, including its recent cumulative
earnings experience by taxing jurisdiction, expectation of future taxable income or loss, the carryforward periods available to the Company
for tax reporting purposes, and other relevant factors.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025, based on the Company&#8217;s history of earnings and its assessment of future earnings, management believes that
it is more likely than not that future taxable income will not be sufficient to realize the deferred tax assets. Therefore, valuation
allowance has been applied to deferred tax assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
July 4, 2025, the One Big Beautiful Bill was enacted (&#8220;OBBBA&#8221;), introducing significant and wide-ranging changes to the U.S.
federal tax system. Significant components include restoration of 100% accelerated tax depreciation on qualifying property including
expansion to cover qualified production property. </span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company has federal and state net operating loss carryforwards of approximately $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_ztKbRXCrVi92" title="Federal net operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001394" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">43.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million
and $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal_iI_pn5n6_c20241231_zmLz9WY01Xua" title="State net operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001396" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">45.4</ix:nonFraction></span> million, respectively.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Federal
net operating loss (&#8220;NOL&#8221;) carryforwards in the amount of $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_zIPLrQoNddBl" title="Federal  net operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001398" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">43.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million have an indefinite life. Federal NOL carryforwards
generated after tax year 2018 are subject to an <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--TaxableIncomeLimitationPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231_zeYmMApwS3Jk" title="Taxable income percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="TVGN:TaxableIncomeLimitationPercentage" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001400" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">80</ix:nonFraction></span>% limitation on taxable income, do not expire and will carryforward indefinitely.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
utilization of the Company&#8217;s net operating losses may be subject to a U.S. federal limitation due to the &#8220;change in ownership
provisions&#8221; under Section 382 of the Internal Revenue Code and other similar limitations in various state jurisdictions. Such limitations
may result in a reduction of the amount of net operating loss carryforwards in future years and possibly the expiration of certain net
operating loss carryforwards before their utilization.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AB_z2FSqcPB0aC9" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company applies the authoritative guidance on accounting for and disclosure of uncertainty in tax positions, which requires the Company
to determine whether a tax position of the Company is more likely than not to be sustained upon examination, including resolution of
any related appeals of litigation processes, based on the technical merits of the position. For tax positions meeting the more likely
than not threshold, the tax amount recognized in the consolidated financial statements is reduced by the largest benefit that has a greater
than 50% likelihood of being realized upon the ultimate settlement with the relevant taxing authority. There were no material uncertain
tax positions as of December 31, 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
January 2025, the Company received a grant of $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation_pn5n6_c20250131__20250131__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__custom--KRHPLLCNewJerseyLimitedLiabilityCompanyMember_zqgGKL6WDAxa" title="Granted, value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation" contextRef="From2025-01-312025-01-31_custom_KRHPLLCNewJerseyLimitedLiabilityCompanyMember" id="Fact001465" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">2.0</ix:nonFraction></span> million from KRHP to further our development of off-the-shelf, genetically unmodified
precision T cell therapeutics to treat infectious diseases and cancers. In August 2025, the Company received an additional grant of $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation_pn5n6_c20250831__20250831__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__custom--KRHPLLCNewJerseyLimitedLiabilityCompanyMember_zhLZ1JKVAfFi" title="Granted, value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation" contextRef="From2025-08-312025-08-31_custom_KRHPLLCNewJerseyLimitedLiabilityCompanyMember" id="Fact001467" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.0</ix:nonFraction></span>
million from KRHP to advance Tevogen.AI. KRHP is affiliated with the Patel Family. KRHP also committed to provide an additional $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation_pn5n6_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__custom--KRHPLLCNewJerseyLimitedLiabilityCompanyMember_zn5H7Muowmsc" title="Granted, value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_KRHPLLCNewJerseyLimitedLiabilityCompanyMember" id="Fact001469" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">7.0</ix:nonFraction></span>
million of grant funding to the Company to be used towards the Company&#8217;s ongoing operational expenses.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Capital
Contribution of Dr. Ryan Saadi, CEO</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
June 30, 2025, Ryan Saadi, the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer, provided the Company with a capital contribution of $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--Capital_iI_c20250130__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__srt--ChiefExecutiveOfficerMember_zql0NLWE6rJ5" title="Capital contributions"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Capital" contextRef="AsOf2025-01-30_srt_ChiefExecutiveOfficerMember" id="Fact001471" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">500,000</ix:nonFraction></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001473" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_805_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock_zXQ2EpWxzJma" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>NOTE
16. <span id="xdx_825_z6V9wgv1qeul">SEGMENT REPORTING</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company operates in <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--NumberOfOperatingSegments_dc_uSegment_c20250101__20251231_zAp3m9CzTs15" title="Number of operating segments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NumberOfOperatingSegments" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001475" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Segment">one</ix:nonFraction></span> operating segment, and therefore <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--NumberOfReportableSegments_dc_uSegment_c20250101__20251231_z9swkaEZ3sc7" title="Number of reportable segments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001477" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Segment">one</ix:nonFraction></span> reportable segment, and is focused on the global discovery, development
and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics. The Company&#8217;s business activities are managed on a consolidated basis through
the development and potential commercialization of pharmaceutical products, which are aimed at the global market in the event that products
are successful in receiving regulatory approvals. The Company&#8217;s determination that it operates as a single operating segment is
consistent with the financial information regularly reviewed by the chief operating decision maker for purposes of evaluating performance,
allocating resources, setting incentive compensation targets, and planning and forecasting for future periods. The Company&#8217;s chief
operating decision maker is the Chief Executive Officer.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
accounting policies for the Company&#8217;s single operating segment are the same as those described in the summary of significant accounting
policies. The Company&#8217;s single operating segment incurs expenses from the development of TVGN 489, which is developed by the Company&#8217;s
research and development department, designed to target various disease indications. The Company has not yet generated revenue in its
operating history.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the segment, the chief operating decision maker uses net loss, which is reported on the consolidated statements of operations as consolidated
net loss, to allocate resources (including employees, property, and financial resources), predominantly during the annual budget and
forecasting process. The chief operating decision maker also uses consolidated net loss, along with non-financial inputs and qualitative
information, to evaluate the Company&#8217;s performance, establish compensation, monitor budget versus actual results, and decide the
level of investment in the Company&#8217;s various research activities. The measure of segment assets is reported on the consolidated
balance sheet as total consolidated assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>
